what: Max credit options are now 5,000, 8,000 and 10,000 a month ($150, $250 and $300); the 15,000 option is gone. Outside limited offers, yearly billing on Plus and Max costs the same as monthly.
Added GPT 6.2 Astra, which raises the top of the AI model range to $1.536 a minute (Ultrafast).
Pro bandwidth overage went from $40 to $50 per 100 GB (2 TB max). The Free plan lists 5 GB of bandwidth.

Added the optional Concurrency Burst add-on at +$0.10 a minute: calls above your concurrency limit connect instead of being rejected. Older AI models moved behind a "Show all" list; their prices did not change.

Yearly prices at 10,000 credits went up: Core from $11 to $12, Pro from $20 to $21 and Teams from $36 to $38 a month. Monthly billing stayed at $16, $28 and $51. The Pro and Teams credit tiers now go up to 8,000,000 credits a month.
Added the Tell 1 (Beta) model at $0.035 a minute, and $0.011 a message for chat agents.
